page.overview:
Who is Alejandro?

Chef Alejandro is first mentioned by park owner John Hammond when Alan Grant, Ellie Sattler, and Ian Malcolm appear before the Raptor Pen. Hammond attempts to dissuade the group (which was assembled by Donald Gennaro to evaluate security risks in the park) from the enclosure by mentioning Alejandro's Chilean Sea Bass. This does not work and the group bare witness to the Velociraptors devour an entire cow.

Immediately afterwards, Alejandro appears serving the tour group their lunch. After the group have a debate over the ethics of the park and its animals, he whispers on Hammond's ear that his grandchilden have arrived in the island. Presumably, Alejandro left alongside the rest of the employees of Jurassic Park on the last ferry and avoided involvement in the subsequent incident.

With the years that passed, it is probable that Alejandro has died of his advanced age.

While Chef Alejandro does not appear in this film, but it seems that his special Chilean Sea Bass is now served at Winston's Steakhouse on Jurassic World's Main Street. Whether or not Alejandro remained with the company or had any involvement culinary or otherwise is unknown.
